Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aarav - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Meenakshi - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vikram - 37 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Naira - 8 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Aarav stands in the park. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Aarav: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aarav throws the ball to Mother.]

Meenakshi (surprised): "Aarav, are you okay?"

[Aarav plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Aarav: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
